description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called GatewayDiscoveryDebugLogView, which displays discovery debug logs from a GatewayConnectionController. It includes UI components for listing log entries, copying logs to the clipboard, and formatting log timestamps.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryDebugLogView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that displays discovery debug logs, allowing users to view, copy, and interpret log data.

methods.name: formattedLog
methods.description: Returns the gateway debug logs formatted as a single string, with timestamps and messages joined by newlines.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a 'HH:mm:ss' string.

methods.name: formatISO
methods.description: Formats a Date object into an ISO8601 string with fractional seconds.
